title: These Nonprofits Want AI Development Paused
script: Four nonprofits just asked a judge to hit pause on frontier AI. Not slow it down. Pause it. They filed in San Francisco, going after Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and SpaceX. Their demand is simple: no next-generation models until companies can prove human control. Why? The complaint points to AI-driven cyberattacks, rogue behavior warnings, and the companies’ own catastrophic risk admissions. Think about that. The people building the tech have warned about the danger. Now a court is being asked whether that risk is acceptable. AI safety just left the lab. It’s in front of a judge.
cta: Follow AI Tested as this legal fight unfolds.
concept: Courtroom vs tech giants: plaintiffs vs defendants lineup, injunction stamp, risk evidence board, blunt closing argument.
